title: AI reconnaissance and enhanced malware coding; defenses (shared secrets, MFA, verify output)
solution_py:
"""Reference solution for 1.4.e. MUST pass 100% of the tests.
Also the default 'blackbox' implementation students can swap out (see the hidden grading tests).

Rule-based detection engine for AI-assisted reconnaissance. Mirrors the four detectors
documented in the problem statement above / the Reference section below. Pure, deterministic, stdlib only."""
import re
from typing import Dict, List


def solve(events: List[str]) -> Dict[str, object]:
    """Scan log lines for AI-assisted reconnaissance patterns.

    Args:
        events: list of server log line strings (any format; may be empty).
    Returns:
        {"recon_detected": bool, "recommended_defenses": sorted, de-duplicated list[str]}.
        When nothing matches, recommended_defenses is [].
    """
    defenses = set()
    recon_detected = False

    for event in events or []:
        # Rule 1 — Port scan
        if re.search(r"(?i)port scan", event):
            recon_detected = True
            defenses.add("rate-limit-port-scans")
        # Rule 2 — DNS burst
        if re.search(r"(?i)dns burst", event):
            recon_detected = True
            defenses.add("dns-query-rate-limiting")
        # Rule 3 — Login burst (login attempts AND an integer >= 100 present)
        if re.search(r"(?i)login attempts", event):
            numbers = [int(n) for n in re.findall(r"\b(\d+)\b", event)]
            if any(n >= 100 for n in numbers):
                recon_detected = True
                defenses.add("login-velocity-controls")
        # Rule 4 — Subdomain enumeration (subdomain AND a query token)
        if re.search(r"(?i)subdomain", event) and re.search(r"(?i)quer", event):
            recon_detected = True
            defenses.add("dns-query-rate-limiting")

    # Always: blanket IP-reputation control once any recon is confirmed.
    if recon_detected:
        defenses.add("ip-reputation-blocking")

    return {"recon_detected": recon_detected, "recommended_defenses": sorted(defenses)}
